Yes. **My top recommendation is David F. Bradley, PhD**, in Bedford, New Hampshire. He specializes in OCD and anxiety, provides telehealth throughout New Hampshire, primarily treats adults, and has extensive OCD/ERP experience—including work at McLean Hospital’s OCD Institute and Dartmouth-Hitchcock. He lists phone **603-634-9561** and email **dbradley@snhocdanxiety.com**. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/bradley-david-f/?utm_source=openai))

Other promising options:

- **Elizabeth Ellis Ohr, PsyD** — Seacoast-based psychologist specializing in OCD and anxiety; provides telehealth and uses ERP. She is licensed in New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and Vermont and works with adults, teens, and parents. ([drbethohr.com](https://www.drbethohr.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Colleen Porter, LCMHC** — Based in Warner; her practice focuses largely on OCD and anxiety and offers telehealth ERP, CBT, and ACT. She reports completing the IOCDF’s Behavior Therapy Training Institute. Phone: **603-945-2028**. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/porter-colleen/?utm_source=openai))
- **Amiti Grozdon, M.Ed., LCMHC** — Offers statewide New Hampshire telehealth, with OCD-specific training in ERP and I-CBT; the practice lists a free 15-minute consultation and several in-network insurance plans. ([sagebrushcounseling.com](https://www.sagebrushcounseling.com/ocd-therapist-new-hampshire?utm_source=openai))
- **Aoife Kennedy, MS, LCMHC** — Fully virtual practice serving New Hampshire, specializing in OCD using ERP. ([therapyden.com](https://www.therapyden.com/therapist/aoife-kennedy?utm_source=openai))

When contacting them, ask:

1. “How much of your practice is OCD treatment?”
2. “Do you provide structured ERP—not just general CBT or anxiety therapy?”
3. “Do you treat my particular presentation, such as relationship OCD, scrupulosity, contamination, harm OCD, Pure-O, or mental compulsions?”
4. “Are you accepting new clients, and do you take my insurance?”

Provider availability, fees, and insurance participation can change, so I’d confirm those directly. The IOCDF notes that provider-directory information is self-reported, although licensure and BTTI completion are verified for its listings. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/porter-colleen/?utm_source=openai))
